[h1]Is this game worth it or not? [/h1]

Yes. This game is worth it for many reasons, mostly because It offers you, the player, an immersive experience that puts you in the shoes of a field operative in a war. This game not only has a great features, but a highly advanced ones in which are iconic to the Bohemia Interactive experience.

[h1]What makes this different from other FPS games?[/h1]

This game makes it different from other FPS games in a vast variety of ways. Not only does this game add open worlds in which allow the player to experience great amounts of scenery (Based off of real life places) it offers many mechanics which were only fantasized about during its time. The Arma series has set a staple in the community for being the original bearer of a world in which everything is totally interactive in every way possible.

[h1] Ballistic Mechanics.[/h1]

Ballistics, or the physics of projectiles is what really gave Arma its name. Just like any other FPS, the ballistics of a game really sets in how it feels when you play it. Sure, bullets that follow the guns crosshair exactly the the center of the screen are nice, but in the Arma series, they have taken it to the next level by adding their own Advanced Ballistics. Bullets are now affected by, Distance, Time, Angle, and even wind. Every shot you make must be made with precision and calculation. One of the Iconic additions of Arma3 was the Subsonic weaponry, it really made shows the player how effective bullet drop actually occurs in reality.

[h1] Interactive Vehicles. [/h1]

In games such as Call Of Duty, being able to operate a vehicle is a once in a lifetime opportunity, with little to no actual experience. Arma has made a staple into FPS Military games by allowing players to interact with the vehicles in everymanner. Vehicles like Tanks, Cars, Helicopters, and Drones, are all Drivable and operable, in which all abide by realistic physics aswell. Helicopters are affected by stress on the rotors, Autorotation is possible, and much more that makes you feel like you are actually operating a helicopter. Vehicles also have a advanced damage system in which different areas that are damaged can affect the performance of the vehicle. For example, if your Tank tracks Are RED, your vehicle will move extremely slow, or not at all, simulating damage. 

[h1] Radar System [/h1] 

One of the newest additions to the game, was a enhanced radar system, along with new jets and a new and improved damage system for them. The radar system was introduced to make dogfighting and arial combat more realistic, and it did exactly that, It added a whole new level on the playing field in which made it more stressfull to operate the jets. Along with jets having radar systems, Anti aircraft Artillery are also given this ability to have a radar to spot other aircraft.   This addition really makes dogfighting a whole new system all together, blowing away all the other gaming competitors.

[h1] Enhanced Movement[/h1]

Moving in a FPS game is vital, especially when there are enemies around the corner. Arma3 has added a totally new meaning to movement, as the standard movements were, Standing, Crouching, and Prone, but in Arma 3 you get 13 more movement factors, by giving you different levels of all the stances. You can lean in both directions, and even lunge out and lean aswell, giving you a heavy advantage over other players. Now you can kill enemies without running from the corner and hoping that your weapon spray will kill the enemy.  Along with new stances, fatigue was added to Arma3. The more items you lug around, the less stamina you get, making you think about what is needed to bring with you, and what might be needed. The Stamina system makes the player become more aware of their movements and actions.

[h1]Enhanced Sound System[/h1] 

There's not much I need say in this section as it is simple. Sound is realistic, in such way that, shockwaves abide by the speed of sound, and speed of light. If you see a bomb go off 2 kilometers away, you will not hear it untill a while after, simulating the speed of sound. Also, the core sounds of the game are quite realistic of what you would hear in real life, although could be improved in my opinon.

[h1] Core Gameplay [/h1]

The core gameplay is really fun, it offers a stars mass of hours of fun that will ensue, there is never a dull moment in this game, with stunning graphics and realism. There is a lot of hours of Campaign to be played with a really good storyline and really good gameplay set many years in the future. After the singleplayer, there is multiplayer, and it really speaks for itself. There is so many different types of servers, and gamemodes. Games such as King of the hill, Invade and Annex, and Life gamemodes, it offers a lot of fun to be had, and that is just the public servers, there are official servers that are COOP gamemodes, and Make your own missions esq gamemodes where other players can complete the missions you make, with no limits. Alternatively there are private servers such as MILSIM units where they take the game to the next level, using player made mods to make the ultimate experience of a serious military unit, which you can join by looking on the fourms and other places. 

[h1] Issues [/h1] 

Like any game there are problems or bugs. The most prominent ones, are Low FPS, RAM Leakage, and bad physics. Arma3 is a great game, and like any tripple A title things can go missed. The most noticable things you will notice is that Falling or hitting things with a vehicle do not respond to the physics engine fluently at all, I have experience my tank skyrocketing into the air at 300 mph, and I have also had my helicopter explode after touching the ground a little too fast. Other moments that really make a player mad is Desync, which is just really bad lag. Sometimes, bullets will not register on players who are De-syncing. 

[h1] Final Verdict? [/h1] 

After everything taken into account, I would have to say I would DEFINATELY reccomend this to anyone who is looking for an awesome FPS experience, The PROS outweigh the CONS in such a massive way, they will be just a temporary setback in your gameplay. This game truly gives you a Die For experience that I think many people are missing out on, due to other games trying to imitate it's style.
